business_summary: Lisheng Sports (Shanghai) Co.,Ltd operates as an automotive sports operator in China. The company engages in the racing venue operation; event and club operation; provision of technology R&D and training; and other businesses. It is also involved in the manufacture and sale of sports equipment; and digital sports business. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
